title: 1992 Torr and Li superconductor paper

tellings.quote: a paper from 1992 with Douglas Torr and Ning Li that showed that the quantization for angular momentum in superconductors resides within the lattice holes of the superconductor and not the Cooper pairs.

plain: A guest named Dave Rossi describes a 1992 paper by the physicists Douglas Torr and Ning Li which, he says, showed that a quantum property of spin in superconductors, materials that carry electricity with no resistance, sits in the gaps of the material's crystal structure and not in the paired electrons that carry the current. Rossi sums up the paper himself without naming another source. He brings it up because, to him, it points toward unusual physics that could matter for exotic propulsion.
